dashboard.embedSiteIdBody: Your Site ID stays stable when you rename the booking slug. Paste it as data-eve-id — no secret API key belongs in the snippet.
dashboard.embedSiteIdNote: Format: chat_ + workspace UUID. Slug embeds still work for older installs.
dashboard.embedAllowedDomainsHint: One hostname per line. Empty = allow any site. Soft check via Referer/Origin — browsers may strip Referer, so this is a light fence, not a secret.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: Everything owners usually ask before flipping the switch.

q1.a: Eve is an AI receptionist for spas, clinics, and salons. Clients message, Eve checks your real calendar, and books the appointment — while you're with another client.

q2.a: No. Open slots come from your connected Cal.com calendar. If it’s not free there, Eve won’t offer it.

q3.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q3.a: No. Start a free trial, connect Cal.com, and start booking from your own workspace page — no credit card needed.

q4.a: Yes. Guests pick EN or VI on the public booking page. Your dashboard language is separate.

q5.a: WhatsApp and voice are on the roadmap for Premium and Enterprise. Web chat and Cal.com booking ship today.

q6.q: Who owns the calendar and data?
q6.a: You do. Eve books into your Cal.com account and keeps workspace data scoped to your tenant.
